summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Miguel Cabrera, a Venezuelan professional baseball first baseman for the Detroit Tigers. It covers his full name, birth date, nickname, and major career honors since his 2003 debut, including two AL MVP awards, four AL batting titles, and 11 All-Star selections. It also notes his position history and his 2012 Triple Crown, the first in 45 seasons.
one_line: Venezuelan MLB first baseman for the Detroit Tigers, known for two AL MVP awards and the 2012 Triple Crown.
key_facts: José Miguel Cabrera Torres was born on April 18, 1983.
Miguel Cabrera is commonly known as "Miggy".
Miguel Cabrera is a Venezuelan professional baseball player.
Miguel Cabrera is the first baseman for the Detroit Tigers of Major League Baseball (MLB).
Since his debut in 2003, Miguel Cabrera has been a two-time American League (AL) Most Valuable Player (MVP) award winner.
Miguel Cabrera has been a four-time AL batting champion.
Miguel Cabrera has been an 11-time MLB All-Star.
Miguel Cabrera has played at first and third base for most of his major league career.
Miguel Cabrera primarily played left and right field before 2006.
Miguel Cabrera claimed the 17th MLB Triple Crown in 2012.
Miguel Cabrera's 2012 Triple Crown was the first in 45 seasons.
